title: Review unwanted account closure while preserving all data
description:
As an account owner, I want a reviewable closure design.

Feature: Review unwanted account closure while preserving all data
  Scenario: Observable acceptance
    Given an unwanted account and existing canonical data
    When closure is proposed
    Then the design awaits explicit user approval and preserves data without deleting or revoking anything during design

Planning only. No new implementation, deployment, paid call or permission is authorized by this record.

## Current next-step plan — 2026-10-17

Account closure remains design-only. Preserve all canonical account membership data and audit history; propose a reviewable reversible closure/deactivation model and data/access consequences, then await separate explicit approval. No deletion, automatic revocation, closure execution or implied approval follows from the account/onboarding plan. Not a prerequisite for basic account acceptance.

Authority: Ryan requested this plan as the permanent Kanbus record. This action updates documentation only. The desired product outcomes are requested priorities, not claims of implementation or hosted acceptance. Existing implementation owners retain their approvals; recommendations needing further scope, release, permission or migration direction stay explicitly gated. No feature code, deployment, paid call, permission change or unrelated merge is performed here.
